text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm working as usual when Super Creek excitedly places a flyer on my desk.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's for a free one-day pottery class.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: They're holding an event at the art museum. It looks like you get to make your own bowls and teacups.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Doesn't it sound like a lot of fun? Why don't you come with me?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Great! Since I don't have anything else to do today, let's get going! ♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: What are you thinking of making?
choice_data_list: Maybe something we can use for training?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Gosh! Hehe, I wonder if you can really make something like that out of clay…

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: You've always got training on your mind, haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I absolutely adore how dedicated you are.
choice_data_list: What are you going to make?
What are you going to make?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Hmm, good question. A teacup or a vase might be nice…

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: But you have to carefully consider the thickness of things like teacups, or they might end up being too heavy to use…

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: And vases are big, so you have to take your time or you might ruin them.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Which do you think is better?
choice_data_list: A vase would make for great interior decoration.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Then a teacup it is!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Hehe, I hope I do a good job! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I try my hand at pottery with Super Creek. We can't come up with anything that would be useful for training, so we both end up making teacups.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Phew… That was pretty hard work, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Having a knack for it is important, but making pottery actually uses more brain power than I expected.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: It won't turn out the way you want it to if you let your mind wander.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: But watching it slowly take shape, a deep feeling of attachment grew inside me…

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: As if it were my own child.
choice_data_list: I can't wait to see how they turn out once they've been fired in the kiln.
I can't wait to see how they turn out once they've been fired in the kiln.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Me neither! ♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Um… Would you like to exchange teacups once they're done?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I actually made a wish on my teacup while I was making it.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I wished for all the tea you drink out of it to be delicious and relaxing.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I was. You're always working hard, so I wanted to give you some comfort.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: But I'll always be here to make you feel better with more than just a cup of tea! Hehe!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Several days later, Super Creek and I enjoy some tea after exchanging our teacups.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It seems like she's learned something valuable from the pottery class.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: It will be difficult, but trying hard is an experience in and of itself!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Let's keep giving it our all! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I try my hand at pottery with Super Creek. We can't come up with anything that would be useful for training, so we both end up making vases.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Great job. Did you enjoy yourself?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: It sure was. I loved watching how focused you were. So cute. ♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: But the whole process involved more detail and patience than I expected.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: It wasn't just about gently pressing the clay with your hands. There was a lot more to it.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I think it was a truly valuable experience.
choice_data_list: I can't wait for them to be fired in the kiln.
I can't wait for them to be fired in the kiln.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Me neither! We should go find some flowers to put in them once they're done.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: It would be lovely to decorate our own rooms with the same flowers.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: That way, we'll think of today whenever we look at them and remember the fun we had! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A few days later, Super Creek and I head out to look for flowers to put in our finished vases.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It seems like she's learned something valuable from the pottery class.
